svg.aria-label: A first request or a backfill wake starts the object on Orange. Orange asks Cloudflare for the export and gets pages of about 4 MB. When no request is in flight, the object on Cloudflare marks itself moved. Then the object serves on Orange, and Cloudflare answers 503 migrator.moved.
